normalization: Only the absolute per-checkpoint build/source path prefix is replaced by <checkpoint>. No compiler flags, definitions, target names or source names are removed.
normalized_benchmark_link_rule:
build cs80_source_factory_benchmark: CXX_EXECUTABLE_LINKER__cs80_source_factory_benchmark_Release CMakeFiles/cs80_source_factory_benchmark.dir/src/tools/source_factory_benchmark.cpp.o | libcs80_core.a || libcs80_core.a
  DEP_FILE = CMakeFiles/cs80_source_factory_benchmark.dir/link.d
  FLAGS = -O3 -DNDEBUG
  LINK_FLAGS = -Wl,--dependency-file=CMakeFiles/cs80_source_factory_benchmark.dir/link.d
  LINK_LIBRARIES = libcs80_core.a
  OBJECT_DIR = CMakeFiles/cs80_source_factory_benchmark.dir
  POST_BUILD = :
  PRE_LINK = :
  TARGET_COMPILE_PDB = CMakeFiles/cs80_source_factory_benchmark.dir/
  TARGET_FILE = cs80_source_factory_benchmark
  TARGET_PDB = cs80_source_factory_benchmark.pdb
interpretation: Dsp.h contains the FIR change; Engine.h adds test-only friend access without object-layout or runtime code change; CMakeLists.txt adds test registrations and a test-only strict-rounding compile option.
source_diff_encoding: fir-source-diff.patch.gz stores the verbatim git diff. source_diff_sha256 refers to decompressed bytes.
